High-level success gates (proposed):
- Accuracy gate: Redwood-generated triage suggestions match OptiHealth labels >= 85% on held-out sample. Owner: Soojin (SE) / Claire (OptiHealth SME)
- Latency gate: 95th percentile inference <= 350ms for 256-token requests on our Dedicated staging. Owner: Redwood infra (Aditya to confirm pool)
- Cost gate: projected unit cost <= $0.004/token (with recommended batching & cache). Owner: Aditya (AE)
- UX gate: end-to-end demo flow with product team with <3 usability issues. Owner: Marissa (CSM)

Proposed 3-week schedule (summary):
Week 0 (setup, Apr 18–21): connectivity, sample export, security checklist, credentials exchange. (Owners: OptiHealth IT + Soojin)
Week 1 (Apr 22–28): run baseline & initial inference runs, iterate prompt templates, collect metrics. (Owners: Soojin + Claire)
Week 2 (Apr 29–May 5): robustness testing, scale test, finalize evaluation harness. (Owners: Aditya + Soojin)
Week 3 (May 6–12): readout prep, exec dry-run, final decision window (target exec slot Apr 25 per your note — proposing we move to May 10 to allow full 3-week run). (Owners: Marissa / Jonas)

Security/evidence checklist needed from OptiHealth: list of permitted IP ranges, sample data schema, whether PHI is present, and current IAM policies. On our side we will provide SOC2 summary, retention policy doc, and audit log sample. Links included below.

Next steps from Redwood:
- I’ll push the two attachments to the Drive folder and share.
- Aditya will confirm Dedicated pool availability & estimated cost.
- Marissa will coordinate an internal exec dry-run and list expected attendees.

Thanks — Soojin
